name: waymark
description: Open-source, self-hosted context layer for software teams and their AI coding agents.

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run build && npm test
scripts.bundle: esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --outfile=bundle/cli.mjs --external:better-sqlite3 --external:sqlite-vec --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
